title: Teacher English Placement Detailed CEFR Rubrics
notice: Objective sections are scored automatically. Writing and Speaking are scored by an administrator using four 1–4 criteria (maximum 16).

bandScale.overall: Writing and Speaking: 4–6 = A1, 7–9 = A2, 10–13 = B1, 14–16 = B2.

criteria.name: Task Achievement
criteria.description: How fully the response addresses the prompt, presents a clear position, and develops relevant ideas with supporting details.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: How logically ideas are organized, paragraphing, cohesive devices, and flow of argument.

criteria.name: Lexical Resource
criteria.description: The range, accuracy, precision, and flexibility of vocabulary used to communicate ideas.

criteria.name: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.description: The variety and accuracy of sentence structures, grammatical forms, punctuation, and error control.

writing.weight: Administrator scores each criterion from 1 (A1) to 4 (B2). Total maximum score is 16.
writing.reviewNote: Writing is not automatically scored; total the four evaluator scores to determine the CEFR band.

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.description: Pace, continuity, hesitation management, and logical flow of spoken communication.

criteria.name: Vocabulary
criteria.description: The range, appropriacy, and precision of vocabulary deployed in spoken answers.

criteria.name: Grammar
criteria.description: The variety, complexity, and grammatical accuracy of spoken sentence patterns.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Clarity of expression, development of response, and communicative effectiveness.

speaking.weight: Administrator scores each criterion from 1 (A1) to 4 (B2). Total maximum score is 16.
speaking.reviewNote: Speaking is evaluated by an administrator listening to recorded audio/video or reviewing transcripts.
